sources.name: ICLR
sources.note: Flat 'non-exhaustive list of relevant topics' under Subject Areas. ICLR 2027 CFP also exists (adds 'and sparse coding' to metric learning, kernel learning).

sources.name: NeurIPS
sources.note: Flat list of topics in the main-track CFP, no sub-items.

sources.name: ICML
sources.note: Topics of interest, each with parenthetical examples; examples split on commas (trailing 'etc.' dropped). Application-driven item kept as one sentence. ICML 2027 CFP lists the same topics.

sources.name: AAAI
sources.note: AAAI-27 'Areas and topics' page (41st AAAI, 17 submission areas). Page text had two garbled run-together labels (GTEP coordination bullet, ROB other-foundations bullet); the label matching the sibling bullets' pattern was used. 'APP: Natural Sciences' appears as a separate bullet next to 'APP: AI for Science (Natural & Physical Sciences)' as on the page.

sources.name: IJCAI
sources.note: The IJCAI-ECAI 2026 (and IJCAI-27, 2025) main-track CFP gives no topic list ('any aspect of AI'; the keyword list is only on the submission site). Groups below are the CFP's official special tracks, plus the topic lists of the AI and Health (https://2026.ijcai.org/ijcai-ecai-2026-call-for-papers-ai-and-health/), AI and Social Good (.../ijcai-ecai-2026-call-for-papers-ai4good/) and AI and Robotics (.../ijcai-ecai-2026-call-for-papers-ai-and-robotics/, topic headings only) special tracks. AI4Tech and Human-Centred AI special tracks give only prose scopes, not included.

sources.name: CVPR
sources.note: Flat list of topics, no sub-headings (the page has one visual break in the list). Page text read through a summarising fetch tool.

sources.name: ICCV
sources.note: Flat list of topics, no sub-headings. Page text read through a summarising fetch tool.

sources.name: ECCV
sources.note: Flat list of topics under one heading 'Topics', no sub-headings. Page text read through a summarising fetch tool.

sources.name: ACL
sources.note: Theme-track discussion questions omitted (not topic names). Industry Track, Student Research Workshop, System Demonstration are separate tracks, not listed.

sources.name: EMNLP
sources.note: Theme sub-items taken without their descriptive examples.

sources.name: ICRA
sources.note: The ICRA 2026 CFP (https://2026.ieee-icra.org/contribute/call-for-icra-2026-papers-now-accepting-submissions/) gives no topic list itself; it points to the official IEEE RAS ICRA keyword list (authors select at least three), used here, grouped by RAS Subject Area.

sources.name: IROS
sources.note: The CFP gives one flat, ungrouped list of topics ('related (but not limited) to the following').

sources.name: RSS
sources.note: No topic list: the RSS 2026 and RSS 2027 CFPs only say they welcome Science/Systems papers reporting novel scientific and systems contributions; no subject areas, tracks or keywords published.
